name: dark_mage
brief: Dark fantasy wizard: pointed hooded cloak, deep violet and charcoal robes with crimson accents, occult runes, leather bracers, tall boots, pale mage face with glowing amulet.

plan.overall_look: Side-view dark fantasy mage in a tall pointed hood that overhangs the head, charcoal-violet layered robes with a crimson sash and occult trim, long hanging sleeve cuffs, leather bracers on the forearms, and tall dark boots. Silhouette reads as a cloaked sorcerer: hood bulk past the skull, robe skirts past the hips/thighs, sleeve overhang on lower arms.

upper_arm_far.visual_notes: Loose charcoal-violet robe sleeve (#352848) covering upper arm far; slight sleeve bulk past body silhouette.

lower_arm_far.visual_notes: Long hanging sleeve cuff in charcoal (#2A2438) with violet lining edge; leather bracer (#4A3A2A) on forearm; dark glove/hand (#2E2838) with crimson ring accent on fingers.

upper_leg_far.visual_notes: Robe skirt panel in deep violet-charcoal (#322848) covering thigh; soft vertical fold suggestion with flat local color only.

lower_leg_far.visual_notes: Robes taper into tall dark boot (#1E1A28) with bronze buckle strip; foot fully booted charcoal-black.

torso.visual_notes: Layered mage robe: outer charcoal (#2A2438) cloak panels over deep violet tunic (#3D2A5C). Crimson sash (#8B1E3D) across midriff. Occult gold-bronze trim (#A67C3D) vertical seam and collar. Amulet disc on chest in muted gold with tiny crimson gem. Robe hem overhangs hips downward onto upper thighs.

head.visual_notes: Tall pointed hood in deep charcoal (#2A2438) with violet inner lining (#4A3568). Hood peak overhangs above and slightly behind the skull. Pale mage face strip visible under hood edge; dark brow shadow. Small crimson rune mark on forehead area. Eyes stay from base (do not paint over eyes).

upper_arm_near.visual_notes: Near-side loose robe sleeve matching far: charcoal-violet (#352848), volumetric overhang at shoulder.

lower_arm_near.visual_notes: Near hanging sleeve cuff charcoal with violet trim; leather bracer (#4A3A2A); dark gloved hand; optional tiny occult rune on bracer in bronze.

upper_leg_near.visual_notes: Near robe skirt panel matching far: deep violet-charcoal (#322848), slight hem overhang past thigh.

lower_leg_near.visual_notes: Tall dark boot (#1E1A28) with bronze buckle; foot fully covered; robe hem edge meeting boot top.

Painting rule: for each active export layer, prepare_outfit_slot_reference then paint ONLY via MCP tools onto design/layers/<layer>.png (fill_parts_on_slot for that layer's body_parts silhouette; fill_rect / draw_line / paint_pixels for details). FORBIDDEN: Shell/PIL scripts or external image generators. Each design file rigid-rotates 1:1 with its body part (no multi-parent split). Clothing MAY overhang the body silhouette — body underlay is alignment reference, not a clip mask; keep proportions sensible. If this matches, say OK and paint layers; otherwise revise the plan.
